patterns.note: The initial full-bleed hero features oversized text that dramatically transforms into a dark-themed content section with a sticky header upon scroll.
The hero uses extremely oversized, bold, sans-serif typography where an image is integrated directly into the letterforms, creating a striking visual identity.

A high-contrast, limited palette shifts dramatically from white-on-dark-brown in the initial hero to white-on-dark-brown for the main content area after scroll, with a brief white background transition.

The hero section undergoes a dramatic scroll-triggered transformation where the background color changes, the large hero text scales down and repositions as a logo, and a full navigation bar and main content area are revealed.

The site features a single, highly dynamic hero section that serves as both an initial brand statement and the primary entry point to the site's content upon interaction, rather than distinct, separate sections.

technique_notes: The initial hero features a large, bold text element with a masked image filling parts of the letterforms. On scroll, this hero text scales down and transitions into a fixed header logo, while the background color of the entire page dramatically shifts using CSS keyframes.
A sticky navigation bar and primary content area are revealed with a fade-in or slide-up effect as the user scrolls past the initial hero, utilizing CSS keyframes for the transitions.
The site uses a video hero effect, likely a dark, subtle video playing in the background of the scrolled state, providing texture and depth behind the main content.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, bold display font for the hero (~8-10x body size) that scales down to a prominent logo, paired with a clear hierarchy of bold headings and readable body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and minimal in the initial hero, transitioning to a more balanced and content-dense layout with generous line spacing in the scrolled state.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic hero section, which dramatically transforms on scroll from an oversized, image-integrated text display into a dark-themed content page with a sticky navigation, creating a strong sense of reveal and interaction.
